_comment: Apollo seismic event catalog (protected). Merged from PSE Long-Period Event Catalog rev.1008c (levent.1008c.xlsx): deep moonquakes A/M, shallow moonquakes H, meteoroid impacts C, LM impacts L, S-IVB impacts S, plus newly identified deep/thermal events (col82-85 A/T). Also includes Gagnepain-Beyneix 2006 + Lognonné 2003 curated list. Z (short-period) excluded. Override with ~/.dssrr_moonquake_catalog.json (the legacy name ~/.seisy_moonquake_catalog.json is still read if the new one is absent).
